paragraphs: A [[curious]] [[theme]] runs through modern [[society]] [[across]] every [[routine]] of daily [[conduct]]. We [[celebrate]] the [[celebrity]] who considers fame a [[vocation]], yet we [[suspect]] that [[bias]] shapes our views. The [[investigator]] of human nature finds [[inborn]] traits and [[instinctive]] drives. Yet [[theology]] and [[secular]] philosophy both explore [[holiness]] and morality. A [[pater]] may [[feed]] his child with [[herb]]s from the garden, but he also feeds the mind. We should not [[curse]] our limitations or [[fantasize]] about a [[paradise]] elsewhere. Even the ancient [[god]] of the mountain has been replaced by reason.

In the [[cave]] of ancient history, humans painted on walls. Later, [[medieval]] scholars studied [[mathematics]] and [[doctrine]]. Today, a [[graduate]] may compose a [[paper]] on philosophy. The [[instructor]] gives [[tuition]] to the [[patient]] student. A [[bilingual]] [[reader]] can enjoy [[fiction]] from many cultures. The [[letter]] remains a powerful tool. A [[visit]] to the library reveals [[non-standard]] manuscripts that are truly [[noteworthy]]. Historians [[reconstruct]] the past from fragments.

Our communities face a [[difficult]] [[problem]]: how to [[govern]] without becoming [[oppressive]]. The [[congress]] holds [[congressional]] debates; the [[unionist]] speaks for the [[union]]; the [[voter]] casts a ballot. Yet [[uninformed]] citizens may [[polarize]] debates. A [[cunning]] leader may [[hijack]] the agenda, or even [[highjack]] a movement. We must [[defy]] such tactics. The public grows [[anxious]] under [[attack]] from misinformation. A [[leading]] newspaper provides one [[indication]] of the mood, while officials remain [[unresponsive]]. Tensions [[erupt]] from [[grassroots]] anger, and the streets are [[seething]]. A [[wilful]] denial of reality and a [[willful]] refusal to compromise only [[fierce]]ly deepen divisions.

Economic life involves [[customer]]s, [[goods]], and [[wholesale]] trade. A [[homebuyer]] may [[bid]] on a house; a [[paycheck]] determines one's [[pocketbook]]. To [[cut]] costs is often [[burdensome]], and a [[mean]] policy can [[degrade]] workers. We should [[encourage]] fair [[pay]] and [[reasonableness]]. A [[timely]] [[measure]] can prevent crisis. The national [[bill]] reaches a [[billion]] dollars, and [[gross]] inequality persists. Companies [[hire]] and fire at will, while the [[storehouse]] of opportunity seems locked. Many choose [[less]] rather than more.

Health and environment demand attention. A [[fever]] can strike the [[body]]; a [[swab]] can detect disease. [[Therapy]] helps us [[recover]]. On the [[grassland]], an [[animal]] may roam. A [[sweater]] keeps us warm; a [[thermostat]] regulates temperature. We must not [[erase]] the [[thick]] forests or spoil the [[thin]] air. Children learn to [[swim]] in clear lakes and wear a warm [[coat]] in winter. The [[swing]] of seasons brings both rain and sunshine.

Technology brings both promise and peril. We need [[mandatory]] safeguards to [[minimize]] risk. The [[volunteer]] firefighter shows [[good-natured]] courage; the [[patrol]] keeps streets safe. A mobile phone is a [[cute]] device, but [[unfocused]] use wastes hours. We should [[suspend]] distractions and [[keep]] our goals in view. Travelers pack a [[carry-on]] bag and face [[involuntary]] delays. Even a [[time-limited]] offer can pressure us into poor choices.

Education is a [[vital]] [[bridge]] to opportunity. [[Each]] student deserves a [[level]] playing field. A [[sensible]] teacher adapts to individual needs. We should not let costs [[hinder]] talent. A [[degree]] opens doors; a [[hobby]] enriches life. The [[field]] of knowledge is [[wide]]. We should [[widen]] access for all.

Cultural life is a [[mixture]] of old and new. We honor tradition while embracing change. A [[prophet]] may predict the future; an artist may create beauty. The [[grace]] of a dancer, the [[rustle]] of leaves, the [[whistle]] of a bird—all inspire us. A [[tune]] can lift spirits. A [[census]] counts people; the press informs them. We should [[reconsider]] harsh judgments and [[recollect]] our shared humanity. In the [[centre]] of town, the [[center]] of attention may shift quickly. What seems [[meaningless]] to one generation becomes [[hip]] to the next.

Personal growth requires effort. We must [[endure]] hardship. It is hard to admit mistakes, but [[self-conscious]] reflection helps. Do not [[swear]] in anger. Instead, try to [[win]] trust. A calm person listens. [[Few]] people achieve greatness without [[sweat]]. The road is long, but [[peace]] awaits those who persist. With [[minimal]] effort, we can achieve little. We cannot [[anymore]] pretend that all problems are [[solvable]]. [[Unfortunately]], some wounds never fully heal.

Relationships shape our lives. A [[mate]] shares joy and sorrow. A [[female]] leader may [[chair]] a meeting. A [[widow]] may [[outlive]] her spouse. We should value every connection. [[Gossip]] can destroy trust; [[unpleasant]] words wound. A kind [[note]] can brighten a day. We should nourish friendships. Let us [[bind]] ourselves to one another with respect.

The natural world teaches humility. The [[interior]] of the earth remains [[unexplored]]. [[Wild]] rivers [[sweep]] through valleys. We should [[sail]] the seas with care. Every [[grain]] of sand matters. The [[cycle]] of seasons [[recur]]s. [[Energy]] is precious. We must not waste it. The climate is changing. We face great challenges. [[Certain]] species adapt to [[adjoining]] habitats, while others perish.

Justice and freedom require vigilance. [[Liberty]] is not free. We must protect it. [[Unilateral]] actions often fail. A wise policy considers the [[maximum]] good. We should reduce harm. Required service can help. The law applies to all. Workers may organize. Every citizen has a voice. We should foster participation. A legal [[case]] may set a [[norm]], and we [[ought]] to follow [[formally]] established rules.

The future remains unwritten. We [[will]] shape it. Our [[legacy]] depends on present choices. Let us [[think]] deeply. Let us [[see]] clearly. Let us act with wisdom. The [[end]] is not yet determined. Though the road ahead may [[curve]] unexpectedly, we should not feel [[embarrassed]] by our past mistakes or fear [[defeat]]. Even in [[awkward]] moments, we grow.
